facts.value: What happens when a university has a global reputation for academic excellence yet remains open to any student eager to learn? facts.value: The world isn’t so big and scary once you get to know the people in it. Students say it takes effort to go out and meet new people, but their expanded worldview and lasting friendships make it all worth it.
